description:
## 🔗 Related Issue
Part of #1245

## 📝 Summary
Implements Phase 1 and Phase 2 of the Bell-LaPadula Mandatory Access Control (MAC) security clearance plugin for MCP Gateway.

### Phase 1 — Core Plugin Implementation
- `plugins/security_clearance/security_clearance.py`: ClearanceEngine 
  with No Read Up, No Write Down, Lateral Bands enforcement
- `plugins/security_clearance/plugin-manifest.yaml`: plugin manifest
- `plugins/config.yaml`: plugin registration
- `SecurityClearanceConfig` Pydantic model with full validation

### Phase 2 — Database Integration
- `plugins/security_clearance/models.py`: 9 SQLAlchemy ORM models (sc_ prefix)
- Alembic migrations: d8a534ca0f9c + 3c272d7a6cee
- Bootstrap default clearance levels 0-5 (PUBLIC → COMPARTMENTALIZED)
- `plugins/security_clearance/repository.py`: ClearanceRepository 
  with DB-first lookup and transparent YAML fallback

### Tests
- `tests/unit/plugins/test_security_clearance.py`: 50 unit tests, 91% coverage

commits.message:
feat: implement SecurityClearancePlugin phase 1 - Bell-LaPadula MAC foundation

Core Bell-LaPadula Mandatory Access Control plugin implementation.

Added:
- SecurityClearanceConfig: Pydantic model with full schema (levels, clearances, bands, downgrade rules)
- ClearanceEngine: core access control logic (no-read-up, no-write-down, lateral communication)
- SecurityClearancePlugin: plugin class with hooks (tool_pre_invoke, tool_post_invoke, resource_pre_fetch, resource_post_fetch, prompt_pre_fetch)
- plugin-manifest.yaml: hook declarations and default config

Features:
- Hierarchical security levels
- No Read Up enforcement: blocks users from accessing tools above their clearance
- No Write Down enforcement: blocks high-classification outputs to low contexts
- Lateral communication: entities in the same band communicate freely
- Field-level redaction with configurable downgrade policy
- Structured audit logging for all access decisions

Related: #1245
Signed-off-by: Katia Neli <nelik@tcd.ie>

commits.message:
feat: add ORM models for Bell-LaPadula MAC tables (Phase 2)

Adds 7 ORM models (sc prefix) for the Bell-LaPadula
MAC security clearance database layer:
- SCLevel: named clearance level definitions
- SCUserClearance: per-user clearance assignments with expiry support
- SCTeamClearance: per-team clearance assignments
- SCToolClassification: minimum clearance per tool/server
- SCServerClassification: minimum clearance per MCP server
- SCClearanceAuditLog: immutable access decision audit trail
- SCDynamicRule: runtime override rules with priority and expiry

All models inherit from mcpgateway.db.Base, use SQLAlchemy 2.0
Mapped/mapped_column style, and include tenant_id for multi-tenancy.

Signed-off-by: Katia Neli <nelik@tcd.ie>
commits.author: Katia Neli

commits.message:
feat: add ClearanceRepository with DB and YAML fallback (Phase 2)

Part of #1245 - Bell-LaPadula MAC implementation.

Adds ClearanceRepository with silent DB fallback for all lookups:
- get_user_clearance: user clearance with expiry check
- get_team_clearance: team clearance lookup
- get_tool_classification: tool/server classification lookup
- get_server_classification: server-level classification lookup
- write_audit_log: immutable audit trail with rollback on failure

All methods return None on DB failure, allowing the plugin to
fall back to YAML config values transparently.

Signed-off-by: Katia Neli <nelik@tcd.ie>
commits.author: Katia Neli
